name: The In Medias Res Hook
axiom: Start inside the consequence; explanation can wait for attention.
trigger: Slide one and the executive summary, where the reader may stop after the first line.

steps.text: Open on a consequence already in motion.
Withhold the cause for exactly one beat.
Rewind only as far as the cause.

antiPattern.violation: A hook that promises drama the rest of the document does not pay off, which spends trust the first page cannot repay.
antiPattern.remediation: Make the opening a moment the body explains. If the body cannot, the hook was decoration.
